description: This file implements a storage layer for integrating Mattermost user and team data with the Focalboard application. It provides methods for user management, team and board access, messaging, and permissions, acting as an adapter between Focalboard and Mattermost APIs and database.

classes.name: MattermostAuthLayer
classes.description: Struct implementing the storage layer for Mattermost integration, providing user, team, board, messaging, and permission management.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MattermostAuthLayer with provided database, logger, API, and configuration.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Closes the connection with the store.
